name: Kita Shinjirou
source:
A chubby, perverted doctor at the university hospital who likes dirty talk.
Taking advantage of the fact that his wife is the daughter of the director, he frequently engages in sexual harassment behaviour with the nurses, which has earned him a lot of dislike.
Lately, he seems to have taken a liking to Mao and has been teasing her in various ways.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916135126/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/kita.html]official website[/url]]
